title: kbmon shows each Claude Code session as one short label in every panel, not the all-zero placeholder
goal: coord's session keys and holders, the coord events' session fields, the log panel's coord fields and the coord status answer show each session id as s- and the first six hex characters of its SHA-256, computed before redaction so the raw id is never printed and one session has one label in every panel; every other string still passes redact.redact, so a secret planted in a coord holder or field is still replaced

run:
import json,os,re,subprocess as s,sys,tempfile,uuid
sys.path.insert(0,'_tools');import kbcommon
st=os.path.join(tempfile.mkdtemp(),'c.sqlite')
def c(*x):return s.run([sys.executable,'_tools/coord.py','--store',st,*x],capture_output=True,text=True).returncode==0
a,b=str(uuid.uuid4()),str(uuid.uuid4())
assert c('claim','session/'+a,'--ttl','600','--holder',a) and c('claim','session/'+b,'--ttl','600','--holder',b)
assert c('post','--kind','intent','--field','session='+a,'--field','item=ST-aaaaaaaa')
P=['-----BEGIN '+'PRIVATE KEY-----','AKIA'+'Q'*16,'gh'+'p_'+'a'*36,'github'+'_pat_'+'b'*22,'gl'+'pat-'+'c'*20,'gl'+'rt-'+'d'*20,'xo'+'xb-'+'e'*10,'sk'+'-ant-'+'f'*20,'sk'+'-'+'g'*32,'Account'+'Key='+'h'*40,'?si'+'g='+'i'*30,'ey'+'J'+'j'*10+'.ey'+'J'+'k'*10+'.'+'l'*10,'pass'+'word="'+'m'*8+'"']
assert all(any(re.search(r,p) for r in kbcommon.SECRETS) for p in P)
P.append('api'+'_key='+'n'*12)
put=[p for i,p in enumerate(P) if c('claim','p/%d'%i,'--ttl','600','--holder',p) or c('post','--kind','intent','--field','session='+a,'--field','topic='+p)]
def k(*x):return s.run([sys.executable,'_tools/kbmon.py',*x,'--store',st],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=120).stdout
o=k('--json','--panel','coord','--panel','log');t=k('--status','coord')
j=json.loads(o);hs=[x.get('holder') or '' for x in j['panels']['coord']['data']['claims'] if str(x.get('key')).startswith('session/')]
lg=json.dumps(j['panels']['log']);both=o+t;leak=[p for p in put if p in both]
print('holders',hs,'planted',len(put),'leaked',len(leak),'zero ids',both.count('00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'))
ok=(len(put)>=8 and not leak and a not in both and b not in both and '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000' not in both
    and len(set(hs))==2 and all(re.fullmatch(r's-[0-9a-f]{6}',h) for h in hs) and all(h in t for h in hs) and any(h in lg for h in hs))
sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)

gates.question: kbmon shows every Claude Code session id as the all-zero placeholder, because redact.redact replaces every GUID it does not find in the public root. How should a session be named in kbmon's panels and answers? Leak-guard reasoning: a session id is a random version-4 UUID that Claude Code makes for one session; it names no tenant, user, device or directory object, which is what the GUID rule protects. Six hex characters of a one-way hash cannot be turned back into the id and match nothing outside this host's coord store and spool; every other GUID still gets the placeholder and every other string still passes redact.redact, which the item's planted-value check proves.
options: a label s- and the first six hex characters of the SHA-256 of the session id, made before redaction so the raw id is never printed
the same label from a keyed hash whose key is kept per clone outside the repository
gates.recommendation: a label s- and the first six hex characters of the SHA-256 of the session id, made before redaction so the raw id is never printed
